notes: The provider sources available here do not say whether the lower models.dev price was ever official for this preview model, nor do they date a price change. The current stable-model price is not proof of the preview model's historical price. Wayback CDX returned HTTP 503, so no archived price-page snapshots could be checked; effective date and official previous price remain undetermined.
